criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official LTX-2.5 supports image/video inputs and this is a transformer quantization; exact ASIN identity and first-10-seconds preservation are untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Publisher benchmark reports all-frame MAE/PSNR and coherent motion for one 249-frame clip; no AIVP run, perceptual panel, product reference or audio decode.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Seed, sigmas, sampler, dimensions and frame count are documented; only one prompt/seed was tested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Public ComfyUI transformer can fit a 24GB card, but additional encoder/VAE assets, exact workflow and specialist setup remain necessary.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: One matched publisher run reports 400.9 seconds versus 780.7 BF16 and 481.5 INT8; repeated timing and failure rate are unknown.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Weights are downloadable without a per-render fee, but compatible hardware, electricity, setup and cost per accepted output are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: LTX-2.x terms explicitly cover production/commercial use below the stated entity-revenue threshold and say Lightricks claims no rights in outputs, subject to restrictions.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: ComfyUI and quantization tooling are documented; no audited AIVP API/MCP or production integration exists.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Public ungated artifact is geographically accessible, but the demonstrated 24GB GPU path is specialist hardware.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate programme or validated transactional demand was found.

analysis: A differentiated, unusually transparent community quantization that makes the transformer resident on a 24GB RTX 3090, but it is not a complete creator product. One publisher benchmark supports a modest evidence floor; exact-product fidelity, audio, repeatability, security and real accepted-output economics remain unverified.
confidence_notes: Publisher repository, benchmark and upstream primary documentation only; no AIVP hands-on run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Blocked pending three-run exact-product first-frame/first-10-seconds success.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; Review blocked pending controlled AIVP evidence.
hard_gates.integration: Blocked: no NVIDIA GPU on current host, model scan incomplete, paid compute not approved.
